reviews.text: This place really truly cares about your dog. They send you the sweetest updates and photos letting you know that your dog is doing great when you’re away. Honestly such a relief to find such a caring place.

We left Trufa with them for the long weekend and it was a great experience. Communication with the accommodation was excellent: they kept us updated on how she was doing and how her day was going, which gave us a lot of peace of mind. We also used their grooming and bathing services, and Trufa came out looking gorgeous and smelling wonderful. We were very happy with her stay and the service we received!
He came back very happy and tired...we are very pleased with the experience
Amazing place! They give so much love and care to doggies and also send you updates about how is it going:) We will return next time for sure! 💖 …
Very friendly and attentive, highly recommended place to leave pets

Magnificent
A welcoming and charming place

Olivia spent half the day at Dogs yesterday. She's only four and a half months old and very attached to people. But she still played with the other dogs. They sent me photos and videos of her there, and she looked so happy.
Thank you, Lidia, for taking such good care of her. Both when she arrived and with your partner afterward. We'll definitely be back! 🩷

Kitty looked gorgeous after her haircut and smelled amazing! We loved the cut they gave her, which was very much in line with our initial requests. She stayed at daycare for a while, and although she's usually a bit nervous, she left very happy, so we were delighted with both services!
Thank you for your review. We're so glad to hear you had a positive experience. We hope to see you again very soon!

A super cool place for dogs!
Fantastic service! I highly recommend them.
Thank you for your review. We're so glad to hear you enjoyed your experience with us. We hope to see you again very soon.

We loved the place; we went to the daycare. The place is wonderful; you can tell they love animals. It's an ideal place if you want your furry friend to make new friends. We'll be back with pleasure, especially because our Toy loved the place and is really looking forward to returning ❤️🐶
Excellent treatment for my pet
The dog bathing service is excellent, I trust them 100% 🙂 …

At Dogs in Town, they treated my Maltese Bichon wonderfully, like a real beauty salon, with pick-up and drop-off included. I received kind, caring, and professional service from all their staff at all times. I will definitely use their services again and recommend them to anyone who asks me about it.

We left our dog Gaspar at Dogs in Town for a week during our vacation and we couldn't be happier with the experience. 🐶❤️

From the very first moment, Lydia took wonderful care of us: she's fantastic and lovely. You can really see the love and dedication she has for the dogs.

Gaspar was happy and we felt so much more at ease knowing he was in such good hands. It's very important for us to be able to go on vacation knowing our dog is well cared for, and with Dogs in Town we achieved that 100%.

Thank you so much, Lydia, for taking such good care of him. We will definitely be back and we wholeheartedly recommend Dogs in Town. 🐾❤️

Trufo visited Dogs In Town Daycare for the first time. He was nice and cool and enjoying himself with lots of other dogs. He looked so happy! It's a real treat to have them here.
Thank you! 🐾
My chow chow got a bath and they made him look gorgeous, they prioritized his well-being and you could see on his face how happy he was to be at Dogs in Town.
Thank you so much for choosing Dogs in Town! We're so glad to hear you had a positive experience. We hope to see you again very soon!
Honestly, it was a wonderful experience, Lidia. She was very attentive throughout, and we kept in touch about our dogs, who were very happy at the daycare. I would definitely do it again.
We're new here and we're delighted with the services and attention they provide, truly 1000 out of 10! We hope more people love our furry friends as much as we do 😍♥️
Theo and Thor had a fantastic day, with activities, games, they were super well cared for, I loved everything and the bath and haircut were great 🥰
Thank you for your review! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ We're so glad to hear you had a positive experience with us. We hope to see you again very soon!
We took my dog ​​to get a bath, the service was exceptional and she was delighted.
My dog ​​looks super handsome and happy! Amazing service! 🫶🏻 …
Excellent service! Highly recommended. We'll definitely be back!
Thank you for your review! We're thrilled to receive your feedback. It was a pleasure serving you, and we hope to see you again very soon.
A spectacular place and magnificent customer service.
My dog ​​loves this place, and the staff is very friendly. It feels like you're leaving your dog with your family.

They are very kind and attentive to detail, and affectionate with all the dogs. The place is spectacularly beautiful. I just wanted them to apply the 15% discount on grooming, and unless there was a mistake in their criteria, they forgot. Thank you.

Highly recommended! 💯💯💯
They are the best. They take care of my dogs both during the day at the doggy daycare and at night at the hotel when we're traveling. They are always attentive to the dogs, and you can tell they truly love them.

Excellent service, the place is inviting, incredible follow-up and information, the bath was perfect (I highly recommend the dental cleaning), and my dog ​​left absolutely thrilled.
Thanks to the team!

Thank you so much for your review! We're so glad we were a part of caring for your furry friend. If there's anything we can do to make your experience even better, we'd love to hear about it. We hope to see you again very soon!

Amazing fun oasis to leave our dog. They took care of every thing.
WHEN WE PICKED UP OUR BaBy HE WAS SO HAPPY. Never seen him like that after hanging out with other doggies.

THIS IS A PLACE I WILL TEUST TO HAVE MY DOG JUST FOR FUN OR WHEN I GO AWAY.

WE MET THE OWNER AND IS A REAL DOG LOVER AND THE CONCEPT HE HAS IS ANOTHER LEVER.
A really great center with super friendly and caring staff. They keep you updated on your dog's condition and follow up with you. Thanks!
They are all lovely
Lola had a great time and they took great care of her. We'll be back.

A truly wonderful experience for my dog ​​Caramelo! He had a fantastic time playing with the other dogs. The service was top-notch; you can really see the passion they put into their work here. 100% recommended! We'll be back soon ♥️
The place is beautiful and the service is excellent. I would definitely choose them again. 🙏😘
